what: A test Subject staged in real time for the late-correction case. Revision 1 was in force from 2026-11-25T18:30Z. An agent-side record referencing revision 1 was anchored by its operator in Bitcoin block 977556 (mined 2026-11-25T19:12:23Z). Revision 2 (with source_revision) was issued only after that, so the anchor is earlier than the correction in fact and not by construction.

revisions.test: Test fixture, not a published figure. Revision 3 repeats revision 2 and adds not_before: the hash of a Bitcoin block mined after the block that anchors the agent-side receipt. It exists so that the order of that receipt and a superseding statement can be derived from bytes.

not_before.meaning: This statement was made after the block with this hash was mined. A verifier takes the block's height from a chain it has validated, not from this member.
not_before.read_from: two public explorers that agreed (transparency/block-readings.json); a report, not validation by the publisher

expected.note: What a verifier can establish, by observation. Every time below is an upper bound ("existed no later than"). Two upper bounds do not order two artifacts, so the order of the receipt and revision 2 cannot be derived from these records alone; it is the publisher's account of the staging. (Forms suggested on the SCITT list, 2026-11-26, by S. and by T. Pinto.)

observations.evidence: Bitcoin block 977556, hash 00000000000000000000b8574baec04b7181b0fe67734b028feef9515f1b2c81; the publisher read this from a public explorer, which is that explorer's report. A verifier needs the header from a chain it has validated itself.
observations.bound: no later than Bitcoin block height 977556
observations.block_time_declared_by_miner: 2026-11-25T19:12:23Z (informative only; compare heights, not block times)

established: revision 1 was the only revision listed in two signed, logged publisher views (sequences 2 and 3)
the receipt referencing revision 1 existed no later than block height 977556
the list containing revision 2 existed no later than 2026-11-26T02:36:46Z by Rekor's clock
revision 3 was made after the block with hash 0000000000000000000134b4c450bcb33c5a37d7f2c659060aeed1e8e202dd5e was mined (it carries that hash in its signed bytes)

given a validated chain in which that block is at a height above 977556: the receipt anchored in block 977556 existed before revision 3 was made. This is the order of the receipt and revision 3, from bytes and heights, with no clock.
not_established: that the receipt preceded revision 2: both facts are upper bounds, one a block height and one a log's clock; neither bounds the other from below. Revision 2 stays unordered; revision 3 does not change that.
the earliest time revision 2 was issued: the publisher states 2026-11-26T02:33:42Z; nothing outside the publisher shows it

that revision 2 did not exist when sequence 3 was signed: sequence 3 is the publisher's own declaration of completeness for this Subject; it commits the publisher and would expose a contradiction, but it is not proof of absence
expected.earlier_views: Each sequence is the file at https://financeratecalc.com/transparency/statement-digests.json as it stood then; retrieve it from the repository history and compare its SHA-256 with list_sha256 and with previous_sha256 in the next sequence.
expected.what_would_establish_the_order: Done for revision 3 (route 1 on the SCITT list, 2026-11-26): it carries not_before. Not done: registration of the superseding statement in the same log as the receipt (route 2), which orders the two only under a profile rule that a superseding statement counts from its registration.
